dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged light-colored perimeters forming interconnected 'O' and 'C' shaped rings with sharp intensity transitions from light tan/grey to a dark charcoal-colored background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of discrete, small high-intensity white/light-grey pixels scattered sparsely across the dorsal-lateral surface, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent closed-ring structures in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, while adjacent open-ring structures form an irregular polygonal chain extending toward the posterior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, localized circular cluster of high-saturation red and pink pixels, indicating a fresh lesion or puncture wound, located on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the head region.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive reticulated 'web-like' pattern topology where high-contrast lines are interconnected rather than appearing as isolated spots.
